occ_lock.description:
OccLock must be present so the frontend can echo it back on widget
upserts — the `set_occ_lock_and_timestamp` trigger rejects UPDATEs
whose lock value doesn't match the row's current value. The SQL
aggregate in SELECT_DASHBOARD_WITH_TAGS_BY_*_QUERY returns it; if this
field is missing here, Go silently drops it during unmarshaling and
the API responds with widgets that have no lock, which breaks save.
